node.title: Q(zeta_128) J_63 residue obstruction
node.statement: At r=5406977, a product of 32 power-residue characters kills the full unit group and all 21121st powers but sends the explicit Jacobi element alpha to 500235 != 1, proving J_63 nonprincipal.
node.notes: RESIDUE CLOSE 2026-07-29: the verifier directly evaluates 31 unit generators and 32 Jacobi sums at 32 embeddings. The calculation is exact, import-free after the unit and Stickelberger dependencies, and uses no BNF or GRH assumption.
